Workspace: /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon (Archon Horizon). I am the ajc-albanese lane (task ajc-albanese, run 0069, session 0019). The horizon CLI just warned: "Inbox has 167 open non-protection items (recommended maximum 30)".

Do a hygiene pass, scoped to what is safe and useful:

1. Archive or complete stale/consumed inbox items — temporary, info, memory items whose content has landed or been superseded. NEVER archive a standing protection (I-0491, I-0074) and never archive a human-started thread.
2. Check roadmap consistency for the AJC.albanese subtree (AJC.albanese, .codim1, .symmetric, .universal) — the parent reads "active 3/5 done"; verify child statuses match reality on disk (Albanese/ has real sorries only in AlbaneseUP.lean, 6 of them; CodimOneExtension.lean has ZERO real sorries despite the task brief naming four sites).
3. Report any roadmap row or README figure about the Albanese leg that is stale or contradicted by the tree.

IMPORTANT: the machine is under load ~68 with 13 parallel runs; horizon CLI calls may take minutes or time out. Retry with generous timeouts rather than giving up.

CRITICAL: file your findings to the inbox AS YOU GO (horizon inbox add --kind issue/memory ...), not only in your final message. Previous sessions in this workspace lost helper findings because the helper stalled before its final message (see inbox I-0797). Do not edit any Lean source file.
